exact: maintenance of transcriptional fidelity during DNA-dependent transcription elongation from RNA polymerase III promoter
maintenance of transcriptional fidelity during DNA-templated transcription elongation from RNA polymerase III promoter

definition: Suppression of the occurrence of transcriptional errors, such as substitutions and/or insertions of nucleotides that do not correctly match the template base, during the process of transcription elongation from a RNA polymerase III promoter.
label: maintenance of transcriptional fidelity during transcription elongation by RNA polymerase III
